_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The capabilities generator fails if the source names below do not match the probe exactly, and the integration suite restores from the images listed under verified — the baseline on every run, the rest in the scheduled version matrix and before a release tag — so neither can drift. The official etcd images are distroless; the suite runs their binaries in the wrapper image the adapter README documents, built FROM the listed image. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: etcd

sources.etcd_snapshot: One snapshot file from `etcdctl snapshot save`
sources.etcd_snapshot_dir: A directory of snapshot files; the newest file is restored (a snapshot carries no timestamp of its own)
